name: Data Converter
description: Convert anything in one DBX workbench panel: 13 formats (JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML) in any combination, JSONPath / jq queries with JSON Schema validation, eight escape tools (URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON / Unicode / Hex / SQL / Regex), batch text to SQL (IN / NOT IN / INSERT), .xlsx / .csv / .tsv to JSON, and Image ⇄ Base64. A Code Gen page turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: 0.1.5 (update): the Convert page now handles 13 formats in any source/target combination — TOML, INI, .env, CSV, TSV, query strings, HTTP headers, cookie strings and HTML tables join JSON / YAML / XML / Properties. A Query page runs JSONPath and jq-style expressions (filters, slices, recursive descent, pipes) and validates data against a JSON Schema draft-07 subset, with schema inference from a sample. An Escaping page converts both ways between URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON string / \uXXXX / hex / SQL / regex. Code Gen turns JSON or CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python, and an Image ⇄ Base64 page rounds out the panel. All eight pages are translated into 14 languages, and everything runs locally: no network, no eval, with hard limits on size, rows and columns.
